## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. English or Chinese is welcome.
[Contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) · [中文贡献指南](../CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md)

## Validation

List the checks actually run, their results, and relevant checks not run. Keep automated checks,
mathematical/narrative review, encoded-frame review and actual listening separate. For real-media
validation, describe scope and hashes without uploading private episode content.

## Scope and rights

- [ ] This change contains reusable framework material or synthetic fixtures, with no episode source,
      media, weights, credentials, environments or private logs.
- [ ] New files are reviewed and listed in `repository-files.txt`; unrelated files are excluded.
- [ ] I have permission to contribute this material under Apache-2.0, and have retained required
      third-party notices and identified different terms.
- [ ] Affected English and Chinese documentation is updated, or the reason it is not needed is stated.

Mention compatibility changes, dependency or redistribution changes, and remaining limitations here.
